summary: Write z = −(gϖ)⁻¹σ(x) ∈ 𝔸_E; the finite character is ψ_f(z_f); at each infinite place the rescaled x_v lies in 𝖴 with σ = −2πi z_v, and the Bessel function transforms by wave(σ); the product over v is the infinite part of ψ(z).

steps.claim: The finite character equals ψ_f at the finite component of z: unipotentChar(S, adelicToFin(x)) = ψ_f(z_f) (unfolding selfDualChar, gIdele and simpleRootSum_adelicToFin).
steps.lean: show unipotentChar .. = ψf E z.2 by aesop]

steps.claim: At every infinite place v, σ of the rescaled component adelicToInf(x)_v equals −2πi·z_v (the scales of consecutive frame vectors differ by the factor κ_v = g Φ_v(ϖ)/(2πi)), and adelicToInf(x)_v lies in 𝖴 (a conjugate of a block unitriangular matrix by a diagonal one); so each local Bessel function is multiplied by wave(σ) = exp(σ − σ̄) (field isBesselFunction of the Bessel system). The product over v of these exponentials is exp of the sum, the infinite part of ψ(z); dividing by ψ_f(z_f) gives the factor ψ(z)/unipotentChar.
steps.lean:
simp [besselFn, fun v ↦ (by simp [z, simpleRootSum, fst_sum, ← sum_mul, ↓adelicToInf_apply,
    ↓basisScale_besselFrame, pow_sub₀, pow_succ', div_eq_inv_mul, coe_kappa, field] : simpleRootSum
    (S.adelicToInf x v) = -π * 2 * .I * z.1 v), stdAddChar, wave, ↓sub_conj, ← Complex.exp_sum,
    mul_sum, sum_mul, ((besselSys ..).tail.isBesselFunction _).2 (S.adelicToInf x _)
    (conj_mem_unitriangular (blockTriangular_diagonal _) (h.map_mem_unitriangularOn _))]
